== Biography ==
Isobel was born in 1732. She passed away in 1821. <ref>Irvine Old Parish Churchyard her gravestone says she died on 5 June 1821, aged 89 </ref>

On 19 September 1769, Roup of houses, yards, etc. belonging to Isobel and Mary Glasgow<ref>https://ayrshirearchives.files.wordpress.com/2019/04/irvine-burgh-catalogue-2017-watermarked.pdf</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1077]] is assessed at 79% (probable). Isobel’s 1732 birth and Irvine burial history fit John Glasgow and Agnes Ferguson’s family sequence, which independently includes James in 1718, John in 1721 and Robert in 1728. The same full couple is stated in her family account.

Probable extension of the documented Irvine household; the grave account does not itself name her father.

Next useful test: Find Isobel’s baptism or an estate entry in the John/Agnes family.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-1127 WikiTree profile export for Glasgow-1127]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
